en.html:
I needed...
a cursed sword-armor like this?

I had no intention of passing the blame for my foster mother's death to anyone else.
As Hikaru had so aptly put it, every sword-armor is a weapon. Cursed or not, it is a tool. The guilt belongs to the human being who used it.

I knew perfectly well, a hundred times over, that this sword-armor was a thing of calamity, and Kageaki Minato used it all the same. There was no one to hate except Kageaki Minato.
But even so, that was no reason to keep this sword-armor beside me from now on—

《ええ。
　二世村正の汚染能力は、武者には及ばない
……けれど〝卵〟を使えば武者を自分の分身
にしてしまえる》



景明
「……」



村正
《その力に冒されない劒冑は、この世に三世わたし
一領ひとつきり。
　だから……貴方に選ぶ余地は無いの》

村正
《……何もかも諦めるなら、別だけれど》



景明
「……」

en.html:
Give up—
that, I could not do.
en.text:
Give up—
that, I could not do.

ja.html:
諦めることが――
　できる筈もなかった。
ja.text:
諦めることが――
　できる筈もなかった。

en.html:
Kageaki"...Rokuhara..."
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"That is what he said."
Muramasa《Yes...》
Kageaki"We go after her."
Muramasa《Yes.》

en.html:
Two years have passed since then.
We have chased Hikaru ever since—
en.text:
Two years have passed since then.
We have chased Hikaru ever since—

ja.html:
あれから、二年。
　俺達は光を追い――
ja.text:
あれから、二年。
　俺達は光を追い――

en.html:
Hikaru has caused annihilation incidents in region after region.
She came to be called the Silver Star.
en.text:
Hikaru has caused annihilation incidents in region after region.
She came to be called the Silver Star.

ja.html:
光は各地で<ruby>全滅事件<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>を起こし。
　銀星号と呼ばれるようになり。
ja.text:
光は各地で全滅事件・・・・を起こし。
　銀星号と呼ばれるようになり。

en.html:
Sometimes Hikaru and I met.
Sometimes we passed each other by.
en.text:
Sometimes Hikaru and I met.
Sometimes we passed each other by.

ja.html:
時に俺と光は出会い。
　時にすれ違い。
ja.text:
時に俺と光は出会い。
　時にすれ違い。

en.html:
We have crushed the "eggs" she scattered.
And for every egg, we have killed exactly twice as many human beings.
en.text:
We have crushed the "eggs" she scattered.
And for every egg, we have killed exactly twice as many human beings.

ja.html:
光のばら撒く〝卵〟を潰し。
〝卵〟のちょうど<ruby>倍の数の<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>人間を殺し。
ja.text:
光のばら撒く〝卵〟を潰し。
〝卵〟のちょうど倍の数の・・・・人間を殺し。

en.html:
And still...
we have not stopped Hikaru.
en.text:
And still...
we have not stopped Hikaru.

ja.html:
そうして……
　未だ、光は止められずにいる。
ja.text:
そうして……
　未だ、光は止められずにいる。

en.html:
Kageaki"...Next time, without fail. This calamity must not be allowed to spread any further."
Muramasa《...Yes...》
en.text:
Kageaki"...Next time, without fail.
This calamity must not be allowed to spread any further."

Muramasa《...Yes...》

ja.html:
景明 「……次こそは必ず。 　これ以上……災厄を広げさせてはならない」
村正 《……そうね……》
ja.text:
景明
「……次こそは必ず。
　これ以上……災厄を広げさせてはならない」



村正
《……そうね……》

en.html:
I murmured it like an oath.
Both the sword-armor and I knew the hypocrisy in it.

It was I who would bring calamity.
From now on—to one person, somewhere.

Staking the sin of killing one evil,
I take on the sin of killing one good.
en.text:
I murmured it like an oath.
Both the sword-armor and I knew the hypocrisy in it.

It was I who would bring calamity.
From now on—to one person, somewhere.

Staking the sin of killing one evil,
I take on the sin of killing one good.

ja.html:
誓うように呟いて。
　俺も劒冑も、その偽善を知っていた。

　<ruby>村正<rt>おれ</rt></ruby>こそが災厄をもたらすのだ。
　これから――何処かの、一人の人間に。

　一つの悪を殺した罪に懸けて。
　一つの善を殺す罪を負う。

I am a warrior of calamity.
